g.text: Lorenz-96 (40 sites, F = 8; 0.05 time units = 6 h). Emulator: 9-point stencil -> 48 ->
48 -> 1 tanh MLP shared by all sites, trained with Adam on 3 000 days of 6-hourly states
to predict the 6-h change, then run autoregressively. Imperfect physics: forcing 7.6
instead of 8. 200 test forecasts; initial error sigma = 0.2.
